preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 1000.
The number of people n in each test case must be between 2 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a_i <= 200000 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each sociability parameter a_i must be a non-negative integer not exceeding 200,000.
The total number of people across all test cases must not exceed 200,000.
The total sum of sociability parameters across all test cases must not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(k) + '\n' + '\n'.join(f'{i} {j}' for i, j in talks)
postconditions.description: The output must first print the maximum number of talks k, followed by k lines each containing two distinct indices of people who talked.
The maximum number of talks k must be equal to the total sociability divided by 2.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= i <= n and 1 <= j <= n and i != j for i, j in talks)
postconditions.description: Each pair of people (i, j) in the output must be valid indices within the range of people and must be distinct.
